speaker: narrator
text: Part four. The man on the roof is *human*.

speaker: narrator
text: His name is Mr. Gray. He owns *the tower*.

speaker: narrator
text: And the phone company. And *the update*.

speaker: hero
text: You did this? *On purpose*?

speaker: boss
text: I wanted people to never put their phones *down*.

speaker: boss
text: Version one worked a little *too* well.

speaker: friend
text: A little? They're *eating* people!

speaker: boss
text: Version two finishes the job. *Everyone* online.

speaker: boss
text: But my only copy is inside your *little friend*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay. I really don't like this *guy*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit's not yours. He's *mine*.

speaker: boss
text: Then let's ask the *crowd*.

speaker: narrator
text: Gray taps his phone. Every zombie's phone *lights up*.

speaker: narrator
text: A thousand heads turn toward the *car*.

speaker: soldier
text: Everybody in! *Now*!

speaker: narrator
text: Jay runs. Bit slips out of his *pocket*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit! *Bit*!

speaker: narrator
text: A gloved hand picks Bit up off the street.

speaker: boss
text: Thank you, Jay. Upload begins at noon. *Sunday*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part five drops in two days.
